name: store
title: Store
description: Every extension your registries list, in the panel: search by name, tagline or category, read the description, palettes and screenshots in the detail pane, install with Enter. What is installed is tagged, what has an update leads under Updates, and the Registries filter shows where they come from.
author: pal

store.tagline: Browse and install extensions without leaving the panel
features: Every extension pal's registry and any registry you added lists, with its tile, tagline and how it stands (installed, comes with pal, update, needs a newer pal), narrowed by what you type
The dropdown filters to Installed, Updates, Registries, or a shelf (Productivity, Developer, System, Media, Reference, Fun, Integration)
The detail pane (`cmd+i`) shows the description, the palettes and the screenshots, with where it comes from, its build and whether it updates by itself
Enter installs an absent extension after a confirm and waits for it to load, updates one that has an update, and opens an installed one; a toast says how it went
Marked rows install, update or remove together; `ctrl+x` removes one installed from a registry (its settings and data stay)
The registries are fetched when the list opens and on `cmd+r`, the cached rows shown meanwhile; a registry that does not answer says so above the list

screenshots.caption: The store as it opens: what has an update first, then every listed extension with how it stands
cmd+I opens the detail pane: what the extension is, its palettes and pictures, where it comes from
Install on Enter; the store page and the install command a keystroke away
